## History

Stella Maynard, a former chum of [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) who taught school after leaving, comes from a poor background. She moves into Patty's Place alongside [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and their friends, living together under the chaperoneship of [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) while maintaining a simple lifestyle. Throughout their time at [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), Stella shares domestic life and studying routines with her housemates, including cheering [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) up during exams by reading childhood stories. As graduation approaches, she prepares to leave Patty's Place with her roommates after completing their studies.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Friend P7](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0007), [v3 ch.Place P52](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0052), [v3 ch.Relationships P0](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0000), [v3 ch.Relationships P14](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0014), [v3 ch.Relationships P44](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0044), [v3 ch.Relationships P51](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0051), +16 more_

## Quotes

> "I was afraid they’d come back. And then our jolly little nest here would be broken up—and we poor callow nestlings thrown out on the cruel world of boardinghouses again."
>
> — Stella Maynard — [v3 ch.Confidences P10](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0010)

> "I love Anne and I like Roy. Everybody says she is making a brilliant match, and even Mrs. Gardner thinks her charming now. It all sounds as if it were made in heaven, but I have my doubts. Make the most of that, Aunt Jamesina."
>
> — Stella Maynard — [v3 ch.Dawn P16](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0016)

> "Nothing seems worthwhile. My very thoughts are old. I’ve thought them all before. What is the use of living after all, Anne?"
>
> — Stella Maynard — [v3 ch.Opens P31](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0031)

> "Oh, my mind agrees with you, Anne. But my soul remains doleful and uninspired. I’m always grubby and dingy on rainy nights."
>
> — Stella Maynard — [v3 ch.Opens P35](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0035)

> "Philippa Gordon! I never thought you were utterly unfeeling. The idea of you saying you’d love to break a man’s heart!"
>
> — Stella Maynard — [v3 ch.Charming P20](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0020)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--stella-maynard.md)

Stella and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) have been intimate friends since their time together at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy). They share a house at Patty's Place alongside other housemates and [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md), where they navigate domestic life, chat about suitors and domestic news, and celebrate shared milestones like published writings. During stressful study sessions at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), the two cheer each other up by reading old dramatic stories written during their childhood [Story Club](../codex/factions.md#story-club) days.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVI. The Glory and the Dream P21](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0021), [v3 ch.Friend P7](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0007), +21 more_

### [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/priscilla-grant--stella-maynard.md)

Stella and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) have maintained an intimate friendship dating back to their days at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy). They live together at Patty's Place while attending [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), sharing their daily lives, exam preparations, and the social gatherings that mark the end of their college years. Together with their housemates, they celebrate graduation and reflect on their time at university.
